verdict.rationale: Skills for Real Engineers is a bundle of SKILL.md instruction files that run inside external agents (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor). It has no product surface of its own that could host a built-in assistant, so this story is a category error for this kind of product. Its slash commands, sub-agent dispatch and 'ready-for-agent' briefs all direct the host agent rather than shipping an assistant of its own, so they do not make the axis applicable.
